description: Governed non-table display grids. These are layouts that visually behave like table, calendar, or key-value grids but intentionally do not use SmartTable/SimpleTable/MatrixTable.

src/modules/Dashboard/components/Dashboa.reason: month calendar cells are interactive date boxes, not records; keep behind the dedicated DashboardCalendarGrid component.

src/modules/HajriTax/HajriTaxDetailEdito.reason: Hajri tax disclosure header aligns editable VAT cells and is protected tax scope.

src/modules/HajriTax/HajriTaxDisclosureR.reason: Hajri tax disclosure rows contain editable tax inputs and responsive card collapse behavior.

src/modules/Assets/components/AssetsWarr.reason: pending warranty invoices use a dedicated responsive queue grid with table roles and a completion action.

src/modules/Settings/components/backup/B.reason: backup import/export count summary is a key-value detail list, not sortable tabular data.
